trigger: 识别一个重复规则 when its declared inputs are available.

inputs.name: feature_instances
inputs.description: 可分别定位的实例引用；不可见实例不能预先加入集合。

inputs.name: size_or_layout_clues
inputs.description: 数量、间距、角度、方向或范围线索；原始标注和派生布置必须分开。

preconditions: 实例可区分且范围明确
Use only this single-action procedure; source or upstream instance references must be supplied.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: One 重复规则记录 in the common envelope; data fields: rule_kind, instance_refs, count, layout.

postconditions: 数量、间距或角度可追溯；不可见实例不直接计数
The typed result and provenance agree with the declared single-action scope; unsupported required fields withhold a resolved result.

implementation.target_environment: Source interpretation or strategy reasoning; no SpaceClaim runtime.
implementation.notes: No standalone deterministic interpreter is claimed. Apply only GU-10 in the hash-bound guidance reference using atomic-reasoning-protocol.md.

ambiguity_checks: 实例身份或重复范围无法区分时拒绝给出确定计数。
不可见实例、被遮挡区域或部分视图不得直接计入 count。
不得从对称、常见阵列或默认间距推断未标注的数量和角度。
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: No geometry handles are acquired; declarations do not mutate or refresh application topology.

failure_modes.condition: The declared action inputs cannot support a unique required result.
failure_modes.detection: Apply the action rejection rules and inspect raw source evidence.
failure_modes.safe_state: Return actionable unresolved fields; retain original evidence and values.

recovery.action: Supply only the missing source or prerequisite, then repeat this action; do not invent geometry or start application execution.

validation.method: Inspect named inputs, result fields, procedure and rejection rules for GU-10
validate_atomic_reasoning.py with an actual source manifest; separately review interpretation against raw material.
validation.expected: 数量、间距或角度可追溯；不可见实例不直接计数

host_checked.notes: Host structure/invariants and bounded independent source evaluation; no automatic promotion.

evidence_level.notes: Candidate. Structural tests cannot establish source interpretation accuracy or any SpaceClaim runtime capability.
